messages:
Sam (Sales): Heads up — Acme is asking for an on‑prem POC quote. They want the Private (on‑prem) platform fee waived for the first 6 months and a 25% discount on support for the pilot. Also asked about 3rd‑party KMS integration being included. Can we get Deal Desk + Eng guidance?
Alex (Solutions): Quick context: POC is for inference at ~50 qps, single rack, 3 models. They'll need admin console access and SSO. Security team already sent a short questionnaire.
Priya (Eng): From infra side — on‑prem package normally includes platform license + standard Bronze support. KMS integration (customer‑managed HSM) is a one‑time engineering integration effort; estimate 10–15 engineer hours for the connector and testing.
Priya (Eng): Operationally, we don't waive platform fees for pilots by default — that drives overloaded capacity. Typical pilot approach: reduced platform fee (50% off) for up to 3 months or full platform fee credit applied to a committed purchase.
Sam (Sales): Customer is pushing for 6 months free because they have procurement constraints. They prefer credits over upfront fees if possible.
Jules (Deal Desk): We can consider a credit structure: 100% platform fee credit for the first 3 months if they sign a 12‑month committed SKU (monthly commit). For 6 months credit we'd need a higher commit (>=18 months or 70% revenue commit). Any technical blockers?
Priya (Eng): No blockers, but KMS work needs to be scoped and included as an SOE line item. If they want it in the POC timeframe, add an upfront one‑time integration fee (we should be explicit).
Otto (CISO - Acme): We need to see SOC2 and a short network diagram. Also confirm there is no telemetry offload to Redwood's hosted control plane outside their VPC during pilot.
Alex (Solutions): @Otto we can provide SOC2 and a network diagram. Control plane optionality: for POC we can run control plane in their VPC or offer split mode — will confirm with Eng.
Maria (Legal): On special terms: if we're doing credits for platform fee, need clear conversion language and termination liabilities. Also, customer requested custom indemnity language in the questionnaire — escalate to legal review.
Sam (Sales): Action items: 1) @Jules can you confirm discount path we discussed? 2) @Priya can you give an estimate for KMS effort and whether split control plane is doable for POC? 3) @Maria any quick blockers on indemnity? 4) @Alex I'll send the questionnaire to everyone.
deploy-bot: New security questionnaire uploaded by otto@acme.com — link: https://files.redwood/qa/acro/1779456789/questionnaire.pdf
Jules (Deal Desk): Confirming deal desk position: We can approve a 100% platform fee credit for 3 months with a 12‑month min commit, plus 25% support discount for first 3 months. For a 6‑month credit we need an 18‑month commit and a signed addendum on conversion credits. Approval subject to Legal signoff and SOC2 delivery.
Priya (Eng): KMS integration: estimate 12 hours for connector + 8 hours validation with customer's ops — total 20 hours. Recommend we bill as one‑time advisory fee of $6,000 (T&M cap). Split control plane: feasible for POC but needs network setup and additional testing window of 5 business days.
Maria (Legal): I'll start a repo for the indemnity ask. Short answer: we can accept limited indemnity, but we need to remove perpetual audit obligations. I'll coordinate with Jules on the conversion/capital credit language.
Sam (Sales): If we go with Jules' approved path (3 months free + 12m commit), can we present a quote today to unblock procurement? Need a short one‑page commercial term sheet.
Jules (Deal Desk): Yes — I'll draft a term sheet. Key bullets I need: platform list fee, monthly commit SKU, support tier pre/post trial, KMS one‑time fee, conversion credit mechanics.
Alex (Solutions): I'll assemble the tech bulleted appendix (models, qps, SSO, KMS notes, control plane choice). Priya I may ping you for exact network ports.
Priya (Eng): Ports: 2379, 50051 (gRPC), 443 for control plane comms if used. Also KV cache traffic is ephemeral.
Otto (CISO - Acme): Good — once we have SOC2 and term sheet we'll expedite procurement. Also confirm that logs at rest remain in our VPC.
Sam (Sales): Noted. Final ask to the thread: @Jules please post the draft term sheet here when ready. @Maria will you flag any redlines early? @Priya can you confirm the one‑time fee and the 5 business day testing lead?
Jules (Deal Desk): Will do. Expect a draft in ~3 hours. Conditions: SOC2 sighted and Legal signoff on indemnity before the credit is applied.
Maria (Legal): Aiming for initial review in 48 hours. If they push immediate exceptions, we'll need exec approval.
Sam (Sales): Thanks all — pushing this to Acme now.
Alex (Solutions): +1 — I'll sync with Acme's infra and set a time for the control plane/net diagram review.
Priya (Eng): I'll block time next week for the KMS connector work if Acme signs the commit.
Otto (CISO - Acme): Thanks — looking forward to the SOC2 and diagram.
Jules (Deal Desk): Draft uploaded: https://intra.redwood/deals/1779456789/draft-term-sheet.pdf (internal only).
Sam (Sales): Received. I'll share a sanitized version with the customer after Legal gives the thumbs up. :thumbsup:
